answer: Each registered agent key pays a nonrefundable 7-token burn to the registry contract; the payer is the key controller, the registry emits the key-hash and burn receipt as verification. N fake keys cost 7N tokens irreversibly, linear, because renaming or resetting an identity still requires a fresh 7-token burn at the summit contract, unlike a mere opal bond that returns; capital is destroyed, not locked, so no dune of refundable stakes remains.
